trap.label: present perfect (notícia)
trap.wrong: Residents have worked in the park yesterday and the city donated tools.
trap.right: Residents worked in the park yesterday, and the city has donated tools.
trap.why: Em português o pretérito perfeito composto aceita ações recentes sem restrição. Em notícias inglesas, uso Past Simple com data definida e Present Perfect para resultado atual.

mcq.q: Residents ___ working in the park for a week.

fix.wrong: Residents have work in the park for years.
fix.right: Residents have been working in the park for years.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Present Perfect: “The city donated tools.” (resultado agora)
Reescreva com for: “They work in the park. They started two weeks ago.”
rewrite.answer: They have been working in the park for two weeks.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “Rita says that they love it.”
rewrite.answer: Rita said that they loved it.
